title: The complete monotonicity conjecture for a logarithmic ratio
statement:
For $\tau\geq0$, define

$$
h_\tau(x)=
\begin{cases}
\dfrac{\ln x}{\ln(x^2+\tau)-\ln(x+\tau)},&x\ne1,\\
1+\tau,&x=1.
\end{cases}
$$

**Complete monotonicity conjecture.** The function $h_1$ is completely monotonic on $(0,\infty)$.
This is a stronger regularity assertion about a logarithmic ratio related to the gamma-function monotonicity problems in the paper. The supplied status evidence marks the associated conjectural result as resolved.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1305.4083

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of May 2013). “Conjecture was confirmed by .”
